package.description: An open-source machine embroidery design platform based on Inkscape.

en-US.description: An open-source machine embroidery design platform based on Inkscape.
en-US.longDescription:
Ink/Stitch is an open-source machine embroidery design platform based on Inkscape. It aims to be a full-fledged, cross-platform embroidery digitizing platform based entirely on free, open-source software. The goal is to be approachable for hobbyists while also providing the power needed by professional digitizers.

Ink/Stitch runs as an extension for Inkscape, providing tools for creating embroidery designs with precise control over stitch types, densities, and patterns.
en-US.name: Ink/Stitch
